html:
Mass protests on 30 and 31 October 2014 against a plan by Blaise Compaore to change the constitution so he could run again, in which crowds stormed and burned the parliament in Ouagadougou.

Compaore resigned and fled. Youth groups and musicians, such as the movement Balai Citoyen, the citizen's broom, led the protests and invoked Sankara. A transitional government survived a coup attempt by the presidential guard in September 2015, which the people and the army defeated, and an election in November 2015 brought Roch Marc Christian Kabore to power. The hope did not last: the jihadist insurgency grew, and the army returned in 2022.
sum: Mass protests on 30 and 31 October 2014 against a plan by Blaise Compaore to change the constitution so he could run again, in which crowds stormed and burned the parliament in Ouagadougou.
